parameters.info: The directory that contains the (2D or 3D) images and beams.
parameters.name: i

parameters.info: The directory for all output files.
parameters.name: o

parameters.info: Filenames of each target/pointing image to be mosaicked. A suffix of 'image.fits' is expected, and this is replaced by 'pb.fits' in order to locate the corresponding beams (which are also required as input).
parameters.name: target-images

parameters.info: The prefix to be used for output files.
parameters.name: n

parameters.info: Also make mosaics of the associated 'model' and 'residual' .fits files.
parameters.name: a

parameters.info: Number of worker threads. Default=0 means all available threads.
parameters.name: j

parameters.info: Use montage for regridding the images and beams. Also regrid the 'model' and 'residual' files, if '--associated-mosaics' is enabled.
parameters.name: r

parameters.info: If the user wants newly-regridded files, this should be enabled. (If '--regrid' is enabled instead, the package will first check whether regridded files already exist.If they are found, regridding will not proceed because this is a time-consuming step.)
parameters.name: f

parameters.info: The cutoff in the primary beam to use.
parameters.name: bc

parameters.info: Sensitivity cutoff in the final mosaic. Pixels with a noise level > minimum mosaic noise / cutoff are blanked in all final products.
parameters.name: mc

parameters.info: Build the mosaic using weight=1 instead of weight=1/noise**2 for the input images.
parameters.name: u

parameters.info: Set the statistic used for noise level estimation in input images. Options are 'mad' (median absolute deviation), 'rms' (root mean square) or 'fit' (Gaussian fit)
parameters.name: s

parameters.info: An initial guess of the noise level in the input images. The default of 0.02 assumes that the pixel values are in units of Jy/beam, so a std of ~ 20 mJy/beam).
parameters.name: g

parameters.info: Central RA (in degrees) of the output mosaic image/cube, if the user does not want to image
parameters.name: ra

parameters.info: Central Dec (in degrees) of the output mosaic image/cube, if the user does not want to image the entire FoV covered by the input images/cubes.
parameters.name: dec

parameters.info: Central velocity/frequency of the output mosaic cube (in the appropriate units of the input cubes)
parameters.name: v

parameters.info: RA range of the output mosaic image/cube (in degrees), if the user does not want to image the entire FoV covered by the input images/cubes.
parameters.name: dra

parameters.info: Dec range of the output mosaic image/cube (in degrees), if the user does not want to image the entire FoV covered by the input images/cubes.
parameters.name: ddec

parameters.info: Velocity/frequency range of the output mosaic cube (in the unit used by the input images)
parameters.name: dv
